 CBSE Class 10th Date Sheet 2027 Out, Download Class 10 Time Table PDF
 The CBSE Class 10 Date Sheet 2027 has been released for the board exams starting on 16 February and ending on 9 March 2027. Check subject-wise exam dates, timings, important instructions and steps to download the date sheet PDF. 
 Posted by Sanjeev Gupta November 13th, 2026 03:10 pm 
 Leave a comment on CBSE Class 10th Date Sheet 2027 Out, Download Class 10 Time Table PDF 
 The CBSE Class 10th Date Sheet 2027 has been released for the upcoming board examinations on its official website cbse.gov.in As per the date sheet, the CBSE Class 10 exams will begin on 16 February 2027 and continue until 9 March 2027 . Students can check the complete subject-wise timetable, including Mathematics, Science, English, Hindi and Social Science, and download the date sheet PDF mentioned below.
 The examinations will be conducted in two shifts: 10:30 AM to 1:30 PM and 10:30 AM to 12:30 PM, depending on the subject. Students can check the complete subject-wise date sheet, subject codes, examination timings and PDF download steps below.

 How to Download CBSE Class 10 Date Sheet 2027 PDF?
 Students can follow these steps to check the CBSE Class 10 timetable on the official website:
 Visit the official CBSE website at cbse.gov.in .
 Open the Latest @ CBSE or Examination section.
 Search for the CBSE Class 10 Date Sheet 2027 link.
 Click on the relevant timetable PDF.
 The date sheet will appear on the screen.
 Check your subject names, codes and examination dates.
 Download the PDF and save it on your device.
 Take a printout for easy reference.
 Students should check the official website for the latest timetable and any revised examination schedule. 
 CBSE Class 10 Practical Exam Date 2027
 CBSE has issued the practical examination, project assessment and internal assessment schedule for the 2026–27 academic session. The practical examinations and assessments are scheduled from 9 November to 19 December 2026 . For schools following the regular academic session, the practical examinations and internal assessments are scheduled from 1 January to 13 February 2027 . Students should contact their schools to confirm their subject-wise practical examination dates. NOTE: The winter-bound schedule does not apply to every CBSE-affiliated school.
 CBSE Class 10 Two Board Examination System 2027
 CBSE introduced the  two-board examination system for Class 10 from the 2026 examination session. Under this system, eligible students get an opportunity to improve their performance in the second examination, subject to the Board’s rules.
 Important points about the system include:
 Students must appear in the first board examination.
 Eligible students can use the second examination to improve their marks in up to three subjects.
 The second examination is conducted separately from the first examination.
 Students should check the latest CBSE guidelines for eligibility and subject-related conditions.
 Students should follow official CBSE instructions for the second examination rather than depending on unofficial updates .
 CBSE Class 10 Admit Card 2027
 After the release of the CBSE Class 10 Date Sheet 2027, students should also keep track of the board examination admit card. The admit card is a mandatory document for appearing in the Class 10 board examinations. CBSE has not announced the release date of the regular students’ admit cards for the 2027 main examinations yet.
 Regular students will receive their admit cards through their respective schools after CBSE makes them available. Private candidates should check the official CBSE website for the latest admit card announcements and download instructions.
 Details Mentioned on CBSE Class 10 Admit Card
 Students should carefully verify the following information after receiving their admit cards:
 Student’s name
 Roll number
 Date of birth
 School name and school code
 Examination centre name and address
 Subject names and subject codes
 Examination dates and timings
 Student’s photograph
 Important examination instructions
 Students should immediately inform their school authorities if they find any incorrect information on their admit cards. They should also keep the admit card safe and carry it to the examination centre as instructed by CBSE.
 Important Instructions for CBSE Class 10 Board Exams 2027
 Students should follow the instructions mentioned in the date sheet and admit card. Some important points are given below:
 Check the subject names and codes carefully.
 Reach the examination centre before the reporting time.
 Carry the CBSE Class 10 admit card to the examination centre.
 Carry only the stationery items allowed by CBSE.
 Do not carry mobile phones, smartwatches or other communication devices.
 Read the instructions printed on the question paper.
 Follow all instructions given by the examination staff.
 Check the official CBSE website for any changes in the examination schedule.

 CBSE Class 10 Date Sheet 2027: FAQs
 Q 1. Is CBSE Class 10 Date Sheet 2027 released? 
 Ans. Yes, CBSE has officially released the Class 10 Date Sheet 2027 on 6 November 2026. Students can check the complete subject-wise timetable and download the official PDF from the CBSE website.
 Q 2. When will the CBSE Class 10 Board Exams 2027 start? 
 Ans. According to the supplied timetable, the CBSE Class 10 Board Examinations 2027 will begin on 16 February 2027.
 Q 3. What is the last date of the CBSE Class 10 Board Exams 2027? 
 Ans. The supplied date sheet shows 9 March 2027 as the last examination date for Class 10.
 Q 4. What is the CBSE Class 10 Mathematics exam date 2027? 
 Ans. The Mathematics Standard and Mathematics Basic examinations are scheduled for 17 February 2027.
 Q 5. What is the CBSE Class 10 Science exam date 2027? 
 Ans. The CBSE Class 10 Science examination is scheduled for 22 February 2027.
 Q 6. What is the CBSE Class 10 English exam date 2027? 
 Ans. The English Communicative and English Language and Literature examinations are scheduled for 26 February 2027.
 Q 7. What is the CBSE Class 10 Hindi exam date 2027? 
 Ans. The Hindi Course-A and Hindi Course-B examinations are scheduled for 3 March 2027.
 Q 8. What is the CBSE Class 10 Social Science exam date 2027? 
 Ans. The Social Science examination is scheduled for 8 March 2027.
 Q 9. What is the CBSE Class 10 Computer Applications exam date 2027? 
 Ans. The Computer Applications examination is scheduled for 24 February 2027.
 Q 10. What is the CBSE Class 10 Information Technology exam date 2027? 
 Ans. The Information Technology examination is scheduled for 24 February 2027.
 Q 11. What is the CBSE Class 10 Artificial Intelligence exam date 2027? 
 Ans. The Artificial Intelligence examination is scheduled for 24 February 2027.
 Q 12. What time will the CBSE Class 10 Board Exams 2027 start? 
 Ans. Most examinations listed in the supplied timetable will start at 10:30 AM. Students should check the subject-wise end time in the original date sheet.
 Q 13. Where can I download the CBSE Class 10 Date Sheet 2027 PDF? 
 Ans. Students can visit the official CBSE website at cbse.gov.in to check the latest examination timetable and download the available PDF.
 Q 14. Will CBSE conduct two board examinations for Class 10 in 2027? 
 Ans. CBSE introduced the two-board-examination system for Class 10 from the 2026 examination session. Students should check the latest Board guidelines for the eligibility and schedule of the second examination.
 Q15. How many subjects are included in the CBSE Class 10 Date Sheet 2027? 
 Ans. The CBSE Class 10 Date Sheet 2027 covers 83 subjects, including academic, language and skill-based subjects.
 Q16. How many days before the examination was the CBSE Class 10 Date Sheet 2027 released? 
 Ans. CBSE released the Class 10 Date Sheet 2027 on 6 November 2026, which was 101 days before the commencement of the board examinations.
 Q17. What is the CBSE Class 10 Mathematics Standard exam date 2027? 
 Ans. The Mathematics Standard examination (Code 041) is scheduled for 17 February 2027.
 Q18. What is the CBSE Class 10 Mathematics Basic exam date 2027? 
 Ans. The Mathematics Basic examination (Code 241) is scheduled for 17 February 2027.
 Q19. Are the CBSE Class 10 practical examination dates the same for regular and winter-bound schools? 
 Ans. No. Practical examinations and internal assessments for regular schools are scheduled from 1 January to 13 February 2027, while winter-bound schools have a separate schedule from 9 November to 19 December 2026.
 Q20. What is the last examination date of CBSE Class 10 2027? 
 Ans. According to the official date sheet, the last examination for Class 10 is scheduled for 9 March 2027.
 Q21. Will CBSE conduct two board examinations for Class 10 in 2027? 
 Ans. CBSE has implemented the two-board examination system for Class 10 from 2026. Students should check the latest official guidelines for the second examination schedule and eligibility conditions.
 Q22. When will CBSE release the Class 10 Admit Card 2027? 
 Ans. CBSE has not announced the release date of the regular students’ admit cards for the 2027 main examinations yet. Students should follow their school announcements and the official CBSE website for updates.
 Q23. What is the gap between the Mathematics and Science exams in CBSE Class 10 2027? 
 Ans. The Mathematics examination is scheduled for 17 February 2027, while the Science examination will take place on 22 February 2027. Students will have four full days between these two examinations.
 Q24. Where can students check the latest updates about CBSE Class 10 examinations? 
 Ans. Students can visit the official CBSE website at cbse.gov.in to check examination circulars, revised timetables, admit card notifications and other important updates.
